requirements.title: Dedicated contact workspace and persisted CRM actions
requirements.expected_result: Contact index opens a full workspace with URL/back-state persistence, mobile one-pane behavior, and persisted add/edit/tag/owner/lifecycle/follow-up/task/thread/family/archive actions.
requirements.implementation_status: Add Contact slice implemented, pushed, deployed to BNA and One Time, and live-smoked: Operations exposes ACTION-CRM-ADD-CONTACT, POST /api/bna/crm/contacts creates or updates one workspace-scoped first-party bna_contacts record, upserts workspace-scoped email/phone/WhatsApp identities, writes a local pipeline event, returns the stable bna_contacts:<id> contact key, and opens the saved contact workspace without external sends, access grants, imports, checkout, or automatic task creation. Archive Contact slice is implemented, pushed, deployed to BNA and One Time, and live-smoked: Operations exposes ACTION-CRM-ARCHIVE-CONTACT, the explicit click archives through the scoped CRM PATCH route with status=archived and create_follow_up_task=false, and deployed HTML readback confirms the action/function are present. Link member slice is implemented, pushed, deployed to BNA and One Time, and live-smoked: Operations exposes ACTION-CRM-LINK-MEMBER in Access/Family, creates only a disabled member shell with access_status=paused and access_enabled=false, the direct bna_contacts aggregate scopes email fallback rollups by the workspace-mapped project before showing communications, support, tasks, or membership, and deployed JS/HTML marker checks confirm the controls are live. Remaining actions include family/student linking.

decisions.next_action: Do not continue broad BNA UI parity in the current One Time packet; keep only regression checks required by shared runtime changes.

decisions.title: Bounded owner-only live email and WhatsApp tests are authorized
decisions.decision: Codex may run bounded, reversible real owner-only test emails and WhatsApp messages only to Shloimie-controlled personal test aliases resolved from secure configuration. Raw destination values must not be hardcoded, pasted, committed, logged, screenshot, or reported. This does not authorize public auto-reply, campaign sends, non-owner contacts, payment/access messages, or bulk sends.
decisions.next_action: Inspect guarded scripts and secure alias readiness before any send; record blockers if aliases or gates are missing.
